Li2023coag-1.notes: Source: Additional file 1 Table S1 (MOESM1 xlsx), converted text/12916_2023_2881_MOESM1_ESM__Table_S1.csv lines 20-24 (ADAMTS13 block, labelled 'ADAMDTS13', Ma 2017). The xlsx merges the Exposure cell over each block, so continuation rows are blank in the converted CSV and cannot be selected by label; the transcribed file copies lines 4-24 verbatim by script with only the Exposure label filled down (source_line column gives the CSV line). Filter MR_keep_UKBBa = T is the paper's inclusion flag for the UK Biobank analysis (claim outcome), leaving 4 SNPs (rs144473590 excluded). Table S1 has no outcome effects (MOESM2 PDF holds only plots), so no recompute. P-value column not mapped because one vWF row reads 'p<1E-320' (non-numeric).
